caption: The drawing depicts an object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object appears to resemble a purse or pouch with a rounded shape and a detailed depiction of a decorative, gold-colored frame with swirling patterns at the top. The main body of the purse-like object is adorned with a brightly colored pattern. The upper section contains a depiction of small houses in yellow, blue, and red with green rooftops and a green tree in the background; the sky above is light blue with a grid-like texture. Below the houses, there are horizontal green and white stripes, and beneath these stripes, the lower portion of the object is filled with a repeating geometric pattern made up of red, pink, turquoise, and yellow elements. The design is symmetrical and appears to simulate the look of needlepoint or beadwork. At the bottom right of the drawing, outside of the main object, there is a small signature reading "C. Christoflels".
title: Purse
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
